text: Talk to Arhein on the northern part of the Catherby Docks to start the quest.
Talk to Councillor Catherine in the north-east of Catherby.
Fill form cr-4p. The answers you provide do not matter.
Hand over the filled form to Councillor Catherine.
Finish talking to Councillor Catherine in the north-east of Catherby.
Grab a piece of charcoal from the cabinet.
Talk to Arhein on the docks about the mayor.
dialogue: I need to find the Mayor of Catherby.

text: Talk to Harry in the fish shop in south-east Catherby about a new mayor.
Fish a new mayor from the aquarium.
Introduce Arhein on the Catherby docks to the new Mayor of Catherby.
Talk to Councillor Catherine about changing the by-laws.
Talk to Councillor Catherine to complete the audit.
Talk to Councillor Catherine in the north-east of Catherby to receive a new form 7r4-5h.
Use form 7r4-5h on the Mayor of Catherby.
Show Councillor Catherine the signed form.
Give Arhein on the Catherby docks the good news.
Talk to Harry in the fish shop in south-east Catherby about a new mayoral fishbowl.
Talk to Arhein on the Catherby docks for a new mayor.
Sail to the small island east of Catherby, then release the Current duck.
Release the Current duck.
Follow the Current duck! It'll end up south-west of Entrana.
Collect your Current duck.
Share what you've learned with Arhein on the Catherby docks.
Get a new duck from Arhein on the Catherby docks, or from your ship's cargo hold.
